description: Create a MediaPipe-ready interactive bubble installation over the live camera: a detected open palm emits soap-like bubbles, body and hand landmarks act as soft colliders that can bat or lift them, a visible body contour is rendered in the same output so the interaction reads clearly, bubbles stay inside the screen box, settle on the lower floor, and pop/fade after a configurable lifetime (default 30 seconds). By default it keeps the bubble count low and disables pose-wrist emission, so bubbles are created only by an open palm. Builds a self-contained Base COMP with a Script CHOP physics solver, Script SOP bubble outlines, Script SOP body contour, camera-background composite, Geometry/Render/Null TOP output, a frame cooker, and live controls for emission rate, gravity, drag, buoyancy, skeleton impulse, bubble repulsion, tracking smoothing, body radius, body contour, camera opacity, lifetime, and bounce. Provide hand_chop_path from setup_hand_tracking and body_chop_path from setup_body_tracking/create_pose_tracking for full interaction.

body_chop_path.description: Optional body/pose CHOP from setup_body_tracking or create_pose_tracking: 33 samples with tx/ty/tz/confidence. Landmarks collide with bubbles.

body_contour_width.description: Line width in pixels for the visible body contour overlay.

body_radius.description: Collision radius around each tracked body/hand landmark, in screen-space units.

bubble_count.description: Maximum number of live/recyclable bubbles in the simulation.

bubble_repulsion.description: Soft collision force between bubbles so they do not collapse into one point.

buoyancy.description: Small upward force countering gravity; keep below gravity for weighted bubbles.

camera_opacity.description: Opacity for the camera background when show_camera_background is enabled.

camera_top_path.description: TOP to use as the visible camera background. The MediaPipe plugin exposes the live camera at /project1/MediaPipe/video.

drag.description: Air drag applied to bubble velocity each second; higher settles faster.

emit_on_open_palm.description: When true, emit only while an open palm is detected in hand_chop_path.

expose_controls.description: Expose live EmitRate/Gravity/BodyRadius/Lifetime/Bounce controls on the container.

fallback_to_pose_wrists.description: Optional fallback: when hand tracking has no landmarks, emit from pose wrist landmarks. Disabled by default so bubbles are created only by an open palm.

floor_bounce.description: Energy retained when bubbles hit the lower screen floor.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration in screen-space units per second squared.

hand_chop_path.description: Optional hand-tracking CHOP from setup_hand_tracking: 21 samples per hand with tx/ty/tz/confidence. Open palm emits bubbles.

hand_emit_rate.description: Bubbles emitted per second while the palm is open.

hide_camera_tracking_overlays.description: When camera_top_path belongs to the MediaPipe plugin, turn off its built-in tracking overlays so only the clean camera appears behind this system.

lifetime_seconds.description: Seconds each bubble remains visible before popping and disappearing.

name.description: Name for the generated bubble-physics Base COMP.

output_resolution.description: Render resolution [width, height] for the output TOP.

palm_open_threshold.description: World-space average wrist-to-fingertip distance required to treat the hand as an open palm.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the body-bubble system is created.

show_body_contour.description: Render the tracked body as a visible contour in the same output as the bubbles, so collisions read as performer interaction.

show_camera_background.description: Composite the camera TOP behind the body contour and bubbles.

skeleton_impulse.description: How strongly moving body/hand landmarks transfer motion to bubbles.

tracking_smoothing.description: Temporal smoothing for body/hand colliders inside the bubble solver.

wall_bounce.description: Energy retained when bubbles hit the left/right/top screen bounds.

name: create_body_bubbles
title: Create body bubbles
